actions.add_comment.description: Adds a reply to the customer or an internal note to a request.
actions.add_comment.props.requestKey.des: Type a key such as SD-123 or a word from the summary to search.
actions.add_customers_to_service_desk.de: Lets existing customers raise requests in a service desk.
actions.add_customers_to_service_desk.pr: Customer emails or account IDs. Data Center: usernames.
actions.add_organization_to_service_desk: Lets every customer of an organization raise requests in a service desk.
actions.add_request_participants.descrip: Shares a request with more people so they can follow and comment.
actions.add_request_participants.props.p: Emails or account IDs. Data Center: usernames.
actions.add_request_participants.props.r: Type a key such as SD-123 or a word from the summary to search.
actions.answer_approval.description: Approves or declines a request that is waiting for approval.
actions.answer_approval.props.approvalId: Empty: the pending approval of the request is answered.
actions.answer_approval.props.requestKey: Type a key such as SD-123 or a word from the summary to search.
actions.create_customer.description: Creates a customer account that can raise requests. On Jira Cloud the connected account must be a Jira administrator.
actions.create_organization.description: Creates an organization to group customers of the same company.
actions.create_organization.props.servic: Also adds the new organization to this service desk.
actions.create_request.description: Creates a customer request in a service desk.
actions.create_request.props.raiseOnBeha: Email of the customer the request is for. Empty: you are the reporter.
actions.create_request.props.requestPart: Emails or account IDs of people who can also see the request.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_requests.description: Finds customer requests by service desk, text and status.
actions.find_requests.props.searchTerm.d: Words to look for in the summary, description and comments.
actions.find_requests.props.serviceDeskI: Empty: every service desk is searched.
actions.get_request.description: Gets one customer request with its status and fields.
actions.get_request.props.includePartici: Adds the people the request is shared with.
actions.get_request.props.includeSlas.de: Adds the SLA timers, such as time to resolution.
actions.get_request.props.includeStatusH: Adds every status the request went through.
actions.get_request.props.requestKey.des: Type a key such as SD-123 or a word from the summary to search.
actions.list_queue_requests.description: Lists the requests that sit in one of your service desk queues.
actions.transition_request.description: Moves a request to another status, such as resolving it.
actions.transition_request.props.comment: A reply the customer sees, added after the transition.
actions.transition_request.props.request: Type a key such as SD-123 or a word from the summary to search.
actions.transition_request.props.resolut: Only used when the transition asks for one, such as Resolve.
actions.transition_request.props.transit: The workflow step to run, for example "Resolve this issue".
description: Service desk for IT and support teams: customer requests, comments, approvals, customers and queues. Works with Jira Cloud and Jira Data Center. For alerts and on-call, use Jira Service Management Operations.
triggers.new_request.description: Triggers when a new request is created in a service desk.
